style: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one high-resolution COLOR photorealistic exercise demonstration for a mobile strength-training app. Landscape 4:3. Exactly ONE athletic adult man with short dark hair, charcoal sleeveless athletic shirt, dark shorts, and white flat training shoes on BOTH feet. Clean uncluttered gym with neutral gray floor and background, soft bright lighting, realistic skin/fabric/metal textures, crisp hands and joints. Frame the entire athlete and functional equipment, subject filling frame with small margins. One pose, one photo, NO collage, NO panels, NO inset, NO labels, NO logos, NO watermark. Anatomically correct limbs, natural joint positions, realistic physical support and load connections. Never depict a recognizable celebrity. Show the exact named exercise and equipment, not a similar exercise.
